reason: The README clearly describes a Weixin-to-DeepSeek Harness messaging integration using QR authorization, Tencent iLink long polling, credential storage, outbound replies, and persistent sessions, but it explicitly states that the project is no longer maintained.

summaries.zh: 通过微信扫码将微信机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持接收和发送私聊文本消息及持续会话。
summaries.en: Connects a Weixin bot to DeepSeek Harness through QR-code authorization, supporting direct text messaging and persistent conversations.

capabilities: Connects a Weixin bot account through QR-code authorization
Receives and sends Weixin direct text messages through Tencent iLink Bot API
Stores bot credentials through the Harness credential service
Maintains long-polling connections and maps users to persistent Harness sessions
Supports multiple independently configured Weixin accounts
